criteria.criterion: US-011 section/heading/metadata structure and source ranges are extracted deterministically.
criteria.evidence: Workspace parser tests pass; multiline inline code is masked before structural extraction and source-range behavior remains covered.

criteria.criterion: US-012 governed identifiers/status metadata are extracted according to artifact contracts.
criteria.evidence: Explicit ID values now require one complete valid governed identifier; malformed values are diagnosed and not promoted to accepted metadata.

criteria.criterion: US-013 links and identifier references are emitted as unresolved candidates with provenance.
criteria.evidence: Link destinations now exclude optional Markdown titles while identifier candidates retain exact source spans and approved governed namespaces.

criteria.criterion: US-014 malformed/ambiguous governed constructs produce source-located diagnostics; partial recovery is not silently valid semantic state.
criteria.evidence: Invalid explicit IDs, malformed metadata shapes, and invalid UTF-8 sequences produce bounded diagnostics without promotion to valid semantic facts.

criteria.criterion: code fences containing fake IDs/links are not treated as ordinary governed references.
criteria.evidence: Existing fence tests and new multiline inline-code structural masking tests pass.
Existing executable-looking-content and HTML-comment safety tests pass; parser behavior remains side-effect free.

criteria.criterion: repeat-run normalized output is equivalent/byte-stable where declared canonical.
criteria.evidence: Existing normalized-output and comment-mask repeatability tests pass.
